purpose: Qualify the released LAMO photographic map on the unchanged Vesta display mesh.

source.label: ../source/reference/lamo-clear.lbl
source.verification: Original PNG downloaded and hash-verified during preparation. Companion attached label inspected from a 65,536-byte archive range; full PDS pixels were not retrieved.

preparation.command: VIPS_CONCURRENCY=1 UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 node --max-old-space-size=2048 tools/objects/dist/prepare-authored.js vesta --write

projectedByteImageReader.claim: Native validity resampling preserves mixed fill footprints; grayscale brightness, RGB channels, dark valid samples, longitude and cropped gaps retain their behavior.

vestaBody.claim: LAMO original PNG dimensions match its label and recipe; Dawn radius anchors, PolyCSS u raster faces, drawing/hit geometry and installed runtime hashes pass.

browser.manual: Selected Clear-filter photography through the dataset control; checked the Dawn mission and DLR source cards; zoomed and rotated the body; toggled optional Shadows through its visible label and returned it off. A direct check() of the styled checkbox was intercepted by its label; clicking that label passed.
browser.limits: Visual and prepared-byte checks, not an independently fitted camera or absolute source-image pixel parity result.

mobile.datasetSelection: Expanded the existing information sheet, selected the photographic dataset, then cycled the handle to peek and waited for its resting position.
mobile.limits: Viewport layout and dataset interaction checked; not a separate touch-gesture conformance run.

limits: The producer mosaic retains illumination and seams, and missing northern coverage.
Exact black is a fill heuristic: photographed black can also be withheld.
The displayed atlas is coarser than the native 20 m/pixel image; geometry remains the 800-face model.
No aggregate build or repository-wide browser suite was run.
